name: app-empty-phone-frame-on-black-stage
title: Blank white phone screen on pure black stage
whatItIs: A pure black wide frame with a single centred phone with a black bezel and an entirely white blank screen with only a status bar.
whatItMeans: A neutral, dramatic stage waiting for content; contrast makes the device shape clear.
techniques: Show a phone as a blank canvas on black to set up a reveal or animation.
Keep the status bar to hint at realism.
Use the white screen as a starting frame for transitions.

vocabulary.definition: An empty device used before content appears.
A pure black background for a presentation.
The top strip showing time and signal.
The first frame of an animated sequence.
